project_type: Monorepo: existing Next.js 14 App Router + TypeScript + Tailwind frontend (Quant Feed) plus a NEW Python FastAPI + Celery graph/vector backend added in a /backend subdirectory. Step 1 of a 3-step production roadmap: replace the ephemeral in-memory/tmp relationship computation with a durable, queryable, entity-aware graph + vector backbone.
build_system: Frontend: bun (bun.lock present) exposed via mise shims at $HOME/.local/share/mise/shims; scripts are next-based (build/lint/dev). Backend: uv for Python env/deps (pyproject.toml + uv.lock), Docker + docker-compose for Neo4j/Qdrant/Postgres dev stack.
test_framework: Backend: pytest (unit tests for relationship-scoring math and schema-mapping/type-adapter layer at minimum). Frontend: no test runner configured; verification is `bun run build` + `bun run lint`.
build_command: Frontend: `export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH"; bun run build`. Backend: `cd backend && uv sync` (build the venv); optionally `docker build` the backend image and `docker compose build`.
test_command: Backend: `cd backend && uv run pytest`. Also `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ruff format --check .`, `uv run mypy .`. Frontend: `bun run lint`.
verification_instructions: 1) Backend lint/type/test: cd backend && uv sync && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy . && uv run pytest. 2) Backend boots: uv run uvicorn app.main:app can import and /health responds (use FastAPI TestClient in a test rather than a live server to avoid port binding). 3) Datastore connectivity (Docker daemon IS available in this sandbox): docker compose -f backend/docker-compose.yml up -d neo4j qdrant postgres, then run the backfill/smoke script and confirm nodes/edges land in Neo4j, vectors in Qdrant, rows in Postgres. Tear down after. 4) Frontend still green: bun run build && bun run lint with BACKEND_URL unset (fallback path) — must behave exactly as today.
snapshot_or_generated_files: uv.lock is generated by `uv sync`/`uv lock` and must be committed. No other generated/snapshot files.
setup_instructions: Frontend deps already installed (node_modules present). For backend: `uv python install 3.11` (already cached), then `cd backend && uv sync`. Docker daemon is running so the dev datastore stack can be brought up with docker compose.
environment_constraints: Network: OPEN_INTERNET (package installs, image pulls, and OpenAI calls all allowed). Host Python is 3.9 but uv provides 3.11.15 (already installed) — backend MUST target 3.11 via uv, do NOT rely on system python3. `node` is NOT on PATH; use `bun` (via mise shims: export PATH="$HOME/.local/share/mise/shims:$PATH") for all frontend commands. Docker daemon RUNS in-sandbox (docker ps works) so Neo4j/Qdrant/Postgres containers can be exercised for real. spaCy en_core_web_trf is heavy; prefer en_core_web_sm (or md) for the sandbox and make the model name configurable via env so prod can upgrade to trf. Embeddings via OpenAI text-embedding-3-large using existing OPENAI_API_KEY (no heavy local model downloads). Tests that hit OpenAI/Neo4j/Qdrant must be mockable and must NOT require live keys to pass in CI; gate real-integration tests behind an env flag.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT push or open PRs (orchestrator publishes). Commit on a local working branch feat/step1-graph-backbone. Secrets only via env vars: add placeholders NEO4J_URI, NEO4J_USER, NEO4J_PASSWORD, QDRANT_URL, QDRANT_API_KEY, DATABASE_URL, BACKEND_URL to .env.example. NEVER hardcode secrets, NEVER commit .env.local, NEVER print the Guardian/OpenAI keys. Do NOT touch the 3D engine (that is Step 2). Frontend backend-integration MUST be behind BACKEND_URL with graceful fallback to current live-fetch behavior when unset or when the backend is unreachable, so the deployed Vercel prototype never breaks.
key_patterns: Domain types live in lib/types.ts (NewsArticle, EconomicNode, EconomicEdge, GraphData, TopicCorrelation, etc.) — reuse these as the seed schema for the graph/vector layer and as the JSON contract the FastAPI /graph/query response must satisfy so the Next.js frontend can consume it unchanged. The existing EconomicEdge = {source,target,strength(0-1),relationship}; the composite weight from three axes must map onto `strength`. Existing scoring lives in lib/ai/relationship-extractor.ts (OpenAI + shared-tag fallback) and lib/freshness/topic-tracker.ts (Jaccard union-find clustering) — the Python pipeline replaces these with entity-aware NER + IDF entity overlap + semantic cosine (Qdrant ANN) + LLM causal classifier. Fetchers (Google News RSS + publisher RSS + Guardian/GNews/NewsData APIs) are in lib/news/*; the backfill must run equivalent fetching in Python (or hit the same feeds/APIs) to populate the stores. The ephemeral store to replace is lib/news/store.ts (/tmp JSON). Frontend API routes app/api/graph/route.ts and app/api/news/route.ts currently live-fetch-first with fallbacks; add a BACKEND_URL-gated branch that proxies to FastAPI and keeps every existing fallback.
directory_structure: Root: Next.js app (app/, components/, lib/, package.json, bun.lock, .env.example). NEW: backend/ holds the Python service — backend/app/ (FastAPI app, routers, config), backend/app/pipeline/ (clean, ner/entity-linking, embeddings, scoring), backend/app/stores/ (neo4j, qdrant, postgres clients + schema/migrations), backend/app/tasks/ (Celery app + beat + workers), backend/scripts/ (backfill), backend/tests/, backend/Dockerfile, backend/docker-compose.yml, backend/pyproject.toml, backend/README.md, backend/.env.example. Frontend changes limited to app/api/graph/route.ts, app/api/news/route.ts, a small lib/backend-client.ts, and root .env.example.
